sources.title: Bangladesh Bank ICT security guideline — official full-text reference

limitations: Partial selection of security controls. No certification, legal compliance or national security grade is inferred.
The reviewed edition is not verified as a fully consolidated current legal instrument; check amendments and sector applicability before operational use.
All entries require manual evidence review. Exclusions, compensating controls and annual/calendar obligations are not decided by metadata.
Data-center Tier/Rating1-4 is a facilities classification, not a security level for applications. This pack does not treat it as a country security grade.
